errors: Refined mesh runs at the planned 10 cycles, r = 60 and 1e-8 tolerances were killed for memory (exit -9) three times, even with 1 worker; fell back to a doubled mesh over 3 cycles at default tolerances.
integrity_issues: The 5zj plan re-asked a question 5p and 5za had already answered (Ai2020's unbooked loss is the 34 parallel-electrode bookkeeping) and called it unseen. Found after the bench, before writing up; logged as a planning error and the ledger hypotheses reported as replications, not findings. The plan entry carries an added note.

doc_friction.issue: Its hint says to read 'the newest LOG.md entries'. On a 1000+ line log that misses facts settled earlier (5p/5za had closed the question I planned); a grep of the log for the plan's key terms before writing it would have caught it.

5zi's 'Next steps' said to decompose the plating overpotential on re-run Ai2020 designs; 5z had already recorded that decomposition per design, so the step was answerable from committed data without new runs.

deviations.why: The planned refined runs could not fit in memory

deviations.result: Both completed; the loss changed by 0.11% and 0.07%

deviations.why: The plan's main question turned out to be closed, so the run added a post hoc analysis of the question 5zi actually left open

deviations.result: Halves Ai2020's overshoot (73 to 43 vs 21) but worsens the other three sets: the separator node does not set kappa*. Labelled post hoc.
